highest tier, then context count, same-grid preference, canonical base-model preference, total archive variable count, and model name

This is a metadata-based eligibility decision, not proof that every file is downloadable today. Access-method metadata was checked, but data-node reachability and file integrity were not exhaustively tested. A Flag is retained because 360-day or noleap calendars can make the indexed endpoint appear earlier than 2014-12; verify the file calendar and actual 1985–2014 slices before analysis. Fixed fields were searched across CMIP experiments rather than historical only. Model-family representatives reduce over-weighting but do not make the remaining models statistically independent.
